scenarios.when: the current connection cannot execute the authenticated catalog read
scenarios.then: state that the current connection did not return model data, ask the user to check the existing connection configuration, and do not call another path or request credentials

scenarios.when: the authenticated catalog returns no media models
scenarios.then: state that no authorized media models were returned and do not substitute the installed static catalog

scenarios.when: the user asks for an exact model ID absent from the authenticated catalog
scenarios.then: state that the current catalog did not return that exact model and offer to show the returned models; do not infer an alias or substitute another model

scenarios.when: no catalog model explicitly declares the requested image, video, or media operation capability
scenarios.then: state that no current model declared that capability and do not recommend a model by name similarity

scenarios.when: a returned model has no input_schema for a requested optional parameter
scenarios.then: report the model without claiming support for that parameter and explain that the directory did not publish the parameter profile

scenarios.when: a returned model has no matching input_schema.operations entry
scenarios.then: report that the model did not publish the requested media operation and do not infer it from a general capability label

scenarios.when: the user asks for the best model without a requirement represented by declared capability, parameter, or operation metadata
scenarios.then: ask for an explicit compatible constraint or show the complete authenticated catalog; do not rank unverified quality, price, or speed

scenarios.when: the current connection returns authenticated model data
scenarios.then: display only returned exact IDs, declared capabilities, properties, non-input constraints, and operations in a user-readable grouped format, then stop without submitting media work
